annotations.title: What changed in the registry for a company

description: Whether the registry record of one company changed between consecutive official ONRC snapshots, and when: one event per snapshot in which anything on the record moved (status, name, legal form, address, registration number). It reports that the record changed, not which field — for the field detail, compare two lookups. Empty for a company that has not changed since the ledger started.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

limit.description: How many recent events to return (1-100).
limit.title: Limit

changes.description: Events, newest first: day, field, old, new.

count.description: How many events are in this answer.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

note.description: Present when there is nothing recorded.

snapshots.description: The snapshots the ledger holds: day, firms, events.
